channel.title: Pro on CoreUI
channel.description: Recent content in Pro on CoreUI

item.title: CoreUI PRO v5.29.0 - External Search in the Multi Select
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO v5.29.0 for Bootstrap. The Multi Select gains external search: the component stops filtering its own list and lets your code fetch matching options from a server or an API, the same way the Autocomplete already does. The release also fixes the Autocomplete external data example.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for React v5.29.0 - Time Granularity in the Date Pickers
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for React v5.29.0. CDatePicker and CDateRangePicker can now drop minutes and seconds from their time selection. The release also keeps internal fields out of submitted form data and fixes CCalendar, CMultiSelect, CAutocomplete and COneTimePassword.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.22.0 - Time Granularity in the Date Pickers
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.22.0. CDatePicker and CDateRangePicker can now drop minutes and seconds from their time selection. The release also keeps internal fields out of submitted form data and fixes CCalendar, CMultiSelect, CAutocomplete, CTimePicker and COneTimePassword.

item.title: CoreUI PRO v5.28.0 - Time Granularity in the Date Pickers
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO v5.28.0 for Bootstrap. The Date Picker and Date Range Picker can now drop minutes and seconds from their time selection. The release also keeps internal fields out of submitted form data, fixes the Calendar, Multi Select, Autocomplete and OTP Input, and includes every fix from CoreUI v5.9.1.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.33 - ngx-scrollbar 19 and Angular 22.2.1 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.33. This update moves the sidebar scrollbar from ngx-scrollbar 13 to ngx-scrollbar 19, cleans up warnings in the Vitest test setup, aligns the template with Angular 22.2.1, and refreshes the bundled CoreUI PRO packages.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.32 - Multi Select Option Groups and Autocomplete on Angular Aria
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.32. This release adds selectable option groups and a custom dropdown header to the Multi Select, rebuilds the Autocomplete on the Angular Aria combobox with a signal forms control and a virtual scroller, and aligns the library with Angular 22.2.1. The Autocomplete changes include behavior changes marked as possibly breaking - see the Migration Notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.32 - Angular 22.2.0, spawn EBADF Fix, and Refreshed Dashboard
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.32. This update moves the template to Angular 22.2.0 and Vitest 5, removes the preserveSymlinks option that makes ng serve -o and ng test fail with spawn EBADF on Angular 22.2, drops the @angular/animations and zone.js dependencies, and refreshes the dashboard. It is the first PRO release after v5.7.23 and covers all changes since then.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.31 - Angular 22.2.0 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.31. This maintenance release aligns the library with Angular 22.2.0, raises the Angular peer dependencies to ^22.2.0, and moves the test tooling to Vitest 5. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.30 - Calendar Week Selection and One-Time Password Fixes
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.30. This release fixes ISO week numbers and week selection in the Calendar, makes the One-Time Password input work correctly with Angular forms and with Backspace, and aligns the library with Angular 22.1.7. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.29 - Multi Select Select All Toggle and Selection Limit
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.29. This release turns the Multi Select select all button into a toggle with a tri-state checkbox indicator and two scopes, adds selectionLimit, and fixes internal controls of the Multi Select, Range Slider and Smart Table that tried to register with a surrounding form. The library is built for Angular 22.1.5.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.28 - Sidebar Nav Tree Variant
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.28. This release adds a tree variant to the Sidebar navigation, makes compact work on the whole c-sidebar-nav, changes dropdownMode="none" so the active route no longer opens any group, and lets collapsing nav groups animate. The library is built for Angular 22.1.5.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.27 - Popover Reference Input and JSDoc Fixes
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.27. This release corrects JSDoc comments across components and, along the way, gives the Popover its own cPopoverRef input for positioning on a reference element. The library is built for Angular 22.1.5.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.26 - Backdrop Cleanup and Angular 22.1.5 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.26. This release clears the Offcanvas and Sidebar backdrop when the component is destroyed, cleans up the aria-*, inert and tabindex bindings across components, fixes JSDoc comments, and aligns the library with Angular 22.1.5. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.25 - Declarative Nav Groups and Enclosed Nav Variants
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.25. This release adds c-nav-group, c-nav-group-items and c-nav-title, so navigation groups can be written in the template, brings the enclosed and enclosed-pills variants to Nav and Tabs, fixes several Sidebar navigation issues, and removes the library’s dependency on @angular/animations. The library is built for Angular 22.1.4.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.24 - Backdrop Fix and API Table Cleanup
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.24. This maintenance release fixes a backdrop opened during the fade-out of the previous one, gives the Multi Select option style a real type, and tidies the API tables of the One-Time Password, Multi Select and Stepper components. The library is built for Angular 22.1.4. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.23 - Angular 22.1.4 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.23. This maintenance update aligns the template with Angular 22.1.4 and refreshes the bundled CoreUI PRO packages, keeping enterprise dashboard projects on the latest stable framework line.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.23 - Dropdown Positioning Fixes and Angular 22.1.4 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.23. This release makes the per-breakpoint alignment of the Dropdown component take effect by marking the menu as statically positioned whenever dynamic positioning is off, cleans up the icon components and the cHtmlAttr directive, and aligns the library with Angular 22.1.4. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.22 - Responsive Dropdown Alignment
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.22. This release lets the Dropdown alignment input take a per-breakpoint map, makes the alignment set on c-dropdown reach its menu, narrows the size/sizing inputs across components to the values they actually support, and corrects the JSDoc behind the generated API tables. The library is built for Angular 22.1.3. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.21 - Offcanvas Container Rendering
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.21. This release adds container and portal inputs to the Offcanvas component, allowing it to render outside its DOM position, and refreshes the Angular CDK, CLI, and development dependencies. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.20 - New Authentication Views, OTP Input, and Vitest
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.20. This feature release adds a complete set of authentication views - magic link, two-factor authentication, and the full password reset flow - together with a new OTP Input view, a search button in the header, a restructured navigation aligned with other CoreUI templates, a migration of the test runner to Vitest, and alignment with Angular 22.1.3.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.20 - Modal Container Rendering
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.20. This release adds container and portal inputs to the Modal component, allowing it to render outside its DOM position. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.19 - Search Button Component and Angular 22.1.3 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.19. This release introduces the new SearchButton component, refactors the widget templates to computed props, cleans up JSDoc comments across components, and aligns the library with Angular 22.1.3. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.18 - Angular 22.1.2 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.18. This maintenance release aligns the library with Angular 22.1.2 and refreshes the Angular build tooling. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Next.js Admin Template v3.3.0 - New Authentication Pages and Next.js 16.3 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Next.js Admin Template v3.3.0. This feature release adds a complete set of authentication pages - including magic link, two-factor authentication, and the full password reset flow - together with new Chip Set and Search Button views, a dashboard synced with the React template, a reorganized navigation, FullCalendar v7, and an update to Next.js 16.3.1.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.17 - Picker Event Order and Focus Handling
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.17. This maintenance release aligns the event order in the Date Range Picker and Time Picker with the form control update, and improves focus handling in the Time Picker. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.16 - Angular 22.1.1 Update and Alert Fix
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.16. This maintenance update corrects the dismissible condition in alerts, aligns the template with Angular 22.1.1, and refreshes the bundled CoreUI PRO packages.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.10.0 - Search Button and Chip Set Demos
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.10.0. This release adds a search button to the header along with its own demo page, introduces a dedicated Chip Set demo, and brings a set of fixes to icons, internal links, and the build pipeline.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.16 - Angular 22.1.1 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.16. This maintenance release aligns the library with Angular 22.1.1, removes leftover logs from the Carousel Item component, and cleans up the Multi Select internals. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO React Admin Template v5.10.0 - Navigation Reorganization and FullCalendar 7
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO React Admin Template v5.10.0. This release aligns the navigation and views with the information architecture of the Bootstrap PRO template, migrates FullCalendar to version 7, adds new component demos, and fixes several issues in the header and the dashboard.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Vue Admin Template v5.9.0 - Navigation Reorganization and FullCalendar 7
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Vue Admin Template v5.9.0. This release aligns the navigation and views with the information architecture of the Bootstrap PRO template, migrates FullCalendar to version 7, adds new component demos, and refreshes the tooling and dependencies.

item.title: CoreUI Data Grid v0.3.0-rc.0 - Right-to-Left Layouts
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI Data Grid v0.3.0-rc.0. This release brings right-to-left layouts to the whole grid - column order, the live reorder preview, resizing, and keyboard navigation - without an option to flip, a separate stylesheet, or a mirrored build. As always, everything below is available in all four editions - JavaScript, React, Vue, and Angular.

item.title: CoreUI Data Grid v0.2.0-rc.0 - Infinite Scroll, Cell Selection, Print & Excel Export
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI Data Grid v0.2.0-rc.0 - the interaction release. It adds infinite scroll, auto row height, pointer-based drag and drop, row reordering, cell selection with clipboard copy, print, and a dependency-free Excel export. Everything below is available in all four editions - JavaScript, React, Vue, and Angular.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.15 - Multi Select Virtual Scroller Fix
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.15. This maintenance release fixes option styling in the Multi Select virtual scroller and refreshes the Angular 22.1 dependencies and build tooling. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.14 - Native CSS Animations for Tabs and Carousel
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.14. This maintenance release migrates the Tabs panel and Carousel components to native CSS animations and refreshes the build tooling. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.13 - One-Time Password Fix and Native CSS Animations
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.13. This maintenance release improves one-time password autofill, migrates the Loading Button and Collapse components to native CSS animations, and restores the Navbar collapse animation input. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for React v5.27.1 - Picker and One-Time Password Fixes
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for React v5.27.1. This maintenance release improves one-time password autofill, fixes the CDatePicker and CDateRangePicker Today button behavior, and refreshes the documentation tooling. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for React v5.28.0 - Custom Container for Picker Dropdowns
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for React v5.28.0. This release extends the container property of CDatePicker, CDateRangePicker and CTimePicker, so their dropdown can be rendered in a container of your choice. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.20.1 - Picker and One-Time Password Fixes
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.20.1. This maintenance release improves one-time password autofill, fixes the CDatePicker and CDateRangePicker Today button behavior, and refreshes the documentation tooling. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.21.0 - Custom Container for Picker Dropdowns
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.21.0. This release extends the container property of CDatePicker, CDateRangePicker and CTimePicker, so their dropdown can be rendered in a container of your choice. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO v5.27.1 - Picker and OTP Input Fixes
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO v5.27.1 for Bootstrap. This maintenance release improves OTP input autofill, fixes string minDate/maxDate handling in the Date Picker and Date Range Picker, and refreshes the documentation tooling. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.12 - Native CSS Animations for Alert
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.12. This maintenance release migrates the Alert component to native CSS animations and refreshes the Angular CLI build tooling. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.11 - Angular 22.1 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.11. This release aligns the library with Angular 22.1.0, migrates the test suite from Karma/Jasmine to Vitest, and refreshes the surrounding dependency stack. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.10 - Angular 22.0.8 Update and Avatar Fix
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.10. This release aligns the library with Angular 22.0.8, fixes a deferred-loading warning in the Avatar component, and expands the API documentation. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.6 - Angular 22 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.6. This update upgrades the template to Angular 22.0.7, refreshes the bundled CoreUI PRO packages, and modernizes the HTTP client configuration for enterprise dashboard projects.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.9 - Angular 22 Update and Sidebar Fix
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.7.9. This update aligns the template with Angular 22.0.8, refreshes the bundled CoreUI PRO packages, and fixes the narrow sidebar brand height for enterprise dashboard projects.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.9 - Escape Key Dismissal for Tooltip, Popover, and Modal
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.9. This maintenance release makes the Tooltip and Popover components dismissable with the Escape key as required by WCAG 1.4.13, and aligns Modal with the same handling. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.8 - Navbar and Dropdown Fixes
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.8. This maintenance release fixes responsive auto-collapse in the Navbar component and resolves a subscription that was not torn down in Dropdown. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.6 - Angular 22.0.7 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.6. This release aligns the library with Angular 22.0.7, refines the Tabs component, and refreshes the surrounding dependency stack.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.7 - Accessibility Improvements
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.7. This release focuses on accessibility improvements across the Autocomplete, Multi Select, Range Slider, and Rating components. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for React v5.27.0 - Accessibility, Security & Picker Improvements
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for React v5.27.0. This release brings extensive accessibility improvements across the CAutocomplete, CCalendar, CMultiSelect, CRangeSlider, and CRating components, security hardening, and a range of picker and stability fixes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.20.0 - Accessibility, Security & Picker Improvements
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.20.0. This release brings extensive accessibility improvements across the CAutocomplete, CCalendar, CMultiSelect, CRangeSlider, and CRating components, security hardening, and a range of picker and stability fixes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO v5.27.0 - Accessibility, Security & MultiSelect Improvements
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO v5.27.0 for Bootstrap. This release brings extensive accessibility improvements across the Autocomplete, Calendar, Multi Select, Range Slider, and Rating components, security hardening through a shared sanitizer, and a range of picker fixes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.4 - Angular 22 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.4. This release aligns the library with Angular 22.0.6, hardens the Autocomplete and Time Picker, migrates the Toast component to native CSS animations, and refreshes the surrounding dependency stack.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.5 - Multi Select Fixes
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.7.5. This is a maintenance release focused on the Multi Select component. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO v5.26.0 - MultiSelect Enhancements
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO v5.26.0 for Bootstrap. This release delivers significant enhancements to the Multi Select component, adding a select-all toggle, selectable option groups, a custom dropdown header template, a native select overlay for browser required validation, and a range of accessibility improvements.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for React v5.26.0 - MultiSelect Enhancements
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for React v5.26.0. This release delivers significant enhancements to the CMultiSelect component, adding a select-all toggle, selection limit support, selectable option groups, a custom dropdown header template, a native select overlay for browser required validation, and a range of accessibility improvements.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.19.0 - MultiSelect Enhancements
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.19.0. This release delivers significant enhancements to the CMultiSelect component, adding a select-all toggle, selection limit support, selectable option groups, a custom dropdown header slot, a native select overlay for browser required validation, and a range of accessibility improvements.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.6.24 - Angular 21.2.14 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.6.24. This update aligns the template with Angular 21.2.14, refreshes the bundled CoreUI PRO packages, and keeps enterprise dashboard projects up to date with the latest maintenance improvements.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.24 - Angular 21.2.14 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.24. This release aligns the library with Angular 21.2.14, fixes a couple of sidebar navigation issues, and refreshes the surrounding dependency stack.

item.title: CoreUI PRO v5.25.1 - Maintenance Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO v5.25.1 for Bootstrap. This is a maintenance release that builds on v5.25.0 with additional fixes and stability improvements. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for React v5.25.0 - Maintenance Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for React v5.25.0. This release rolls up maintenance improvements and keeps CoreUI PRO for React projects current. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO v5.25.0 - Maintenance Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO v5.25.0 for Bootstrap. This release rolls up maintenance improvements and keeps CoreUI PRO projects current. No breaking changes were announced in the published release notes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.6.23 - Angular 21.2.12 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.6.23. This update aligns the template with Angular 21.2.12, refreshes the bundled CoreUI PRO packages, and keeps enterprise dashboard projects up to date with the latest maintenance improvements.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.23 - Angular 21.2.12 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.23. This release aligns the library with Angular 21.2.12, refreshes the surrounding dependency stack, and keeps CoreUI PRO applications current with the latest maintenance updates.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.9.0
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.9.0 on May 5, 2026! This update focuses on comprehensive dependency updates and improved developer experience—keeping your enterprise admin template modern, secure, and maintainable.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.6.22 - Angular 21.2.10 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.6.22. This security and maintenance update brings full support for Angular 21.2.10, includes updated CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.22 components, and addresses multiple security vulnerabilities. This release ensures your enterprise Angular admin dashboard runs securely with the latest framework improvements and all exclusive PRO features.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.22 - Angular 21.2.10 Security Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.22. This security and maintenance update brings full support for Angular 21.2.10 and includes critical security patches addressing multiple vulnerabilities in hono, lodash, path-to-regexp, picomatch, brace-expansion, and follow-redirects. This update ensures your enterprise Angular applications run securely with the latest framework improvements and comprehensive dependency updates.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Next.js Admin Template v3.2.0
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Next.js Admin Template v3.2.0. This update introduces new Chip components, critical memory leak fixes in AppHeader and MainChart, comprehensive AI-assistant documentation, and latest dependency updates for building robust enterprise Next.js admin applications.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Vue Admin Template v5.8.0
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Vue Admin Template v5.8.0. This update brings Vue Router 5.0 compatibility, new Chip components, comprehensive AI-assistant documentation, and all exclusive CoreUI PRO components for building sophisticated enterprise Vue.js admin dashboards with enhanced developer experience.

item.title: CoreUI PRO React Admin Template v5.9.0
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO React Admin Template v5.9.0 on March 30, 2026! This update brings JSX file extension refactoring, critical memory leak fixes, comprehensive dependency updates, and improved code organization to deliver a more maintainable and performant enterprise admin template.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.8.0
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Bootstrap Admin Template v5.8.0 on March 28, 2026! This update brings AI-friendly documentation, new Chip components, enhanced examples, and comprehensive dependency updates to deliver a more powerful and maintainable enterprise admin template experience.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for React v5.24.1 - Maintenance Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for React v5.24.1. This maintenance release includes bug fixes and improvements while maintaining all functionality from v5.24.0, including the powerful Calendar component with custom cell rendering and quarter selection, plus Chip and Chip Input components.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.18.0 - Chip Components & PRO Features
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Vue v5.18.0. This update introduces powerful new Chip and Chip Input components, plus all exclusive PRO components for building sophisticated enterprise Vue.js applications with Vue 3 compatibility.

item.title: CoreUI PRO v5.24.2 - Maintenance Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce CoreUI PRO v5.24.2 for Bootstrap. This maintenance release includes bug fixes and improvements while maintaining all functionality from v5.24.0, including the powerful Calendar component enhancements with custom cell rendering and quarter selection capabilities.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.6.21 - Security Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.6.21. This critical security update brings full support for Angular 21.2.5, includes updated CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.21 components, and addresses multiple security vulnerabilities. This release ensures your enterprise Angular admin dashboard runs securely with the latest framework improvements and all exclusive PRO features.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.21 - Angular 21.2.5 Security Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.21. This critical security update brings full support for Angular 21.2.5 and includes important security patches addressing multiple vulnerabilities in flatted, socket.io-parser, and undici packages. This update ensures your enterprise Angular applications run securely with the latest framework improvements and comprehensive dependency updates.

item.title: CoreUI PRO v5.24.1 - Release Tag Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce CoreUI PRO v5.24.1 for Bootstrap. This release is a tag update maintaining all functionality from v5.24.0, including the powerful Calendar component enhancements with custom cell rendering and quarter selection capabilities.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.20 - Angular 21.2.3 Security Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.20. This important security update brings full support for Angular 21.2.3, includes critical security patches for the hono package vulnerability (GHSA-v8w9-8mx6-g223), and comprehensive dependency updates to ensure your enterprise Angular applications run securely with the latest framework improvements.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.19 - ESLint 10 & Tooling Updates
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.19. This maintenance update brings support for ESLint 10, updates to the latest Angular 21.2.1 CLI and build tools, and comprehensive development dependency updates to enhance your enterprise Angular development experience.

item.title: CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.18 - Angular 21.2.1 & Security Updates
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI PRO for Angular v5.6.18. This maintenance update brings full support for Angular 21.2.1, includes critical security patches, and comprehensive dependency updates to ensure your enterprise Angular applications run with the latest framework improvements and security fixes.

item.title: CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template v5.6.17
